summary: Apply koru.yaml autonomy strategy defaults to koru autonomous up

delivery.outcome: A project's declared autonomy.strategy in koru.yaml configures every `up` loop start, so a long-running `koru autonomous up` service resolves the same idle-discovery and planning-assistant defaults as the `koru auto` alias, while explicit CLI options and environment overrides keep priority.
nonGoals: Change any default in the packaged strategy or in argparse
Change which discovery tools the idle fallback chain runs, including the paid nxdo planner
Restrict the fallback chain to the tools a strategy declares
Deploy or restart any running autonomous service

architecture.decision: Key the strategy defaults on the resolved `up` action instead of the `koru auto` alias flag, and collect the caller's explicit argv options for every `up` so the existing user-option precedence keeps working for the explicit command. Only the alias still expands the auto-mode default argument set.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit, or pass the explicit flag the service needs (for example `--no-scan-after-idle-queue`), which wins over the strategy either way.

commands: .venv/bin/pytest -o addopts='' -q tests/test_autonomous.py tests/test_autonomy_strategy.py tests/test_planning_llm.py tests/test_scan_phase.py tests/test_cycle_backlog_promotion.py tests/test_monag_discovery.py
